# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

- [x] ▶ review (fa-review) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39130489993) · started 13:12 · done 13:27 ✅

(`fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed` is CC ~9 with the empty-log branches uncovered; `detectFailedChecks` regressed because the per-check resolution block was inlined into it.)

The functional gh-1045 fix itself is correct — the mixed-shape replay, loud per-check diagnostics and AC2 tests all pass (4133/0 locally) — but the gate cannot merge code above threshold. Suggested shape, matching the existing small-helper style of this file:

```javascript
function fetchGithubJobLogsDetailed(jobId, scm, owner, repo) { /* /jobs/{id} branch */ }
function fetchGithubCheckRunLogsDetailed(checkRunId, scm, owner, repo) { /* bare /runs/{id} branch */ }

    /* dispatch only: /jobs/{id} → job helper; /actions/runs/{id} → run path; bare /runs/{id} → check-run helper */
}
```

and extract the per-check `ghResult`/`jenkinsResult` assembly from `detectFailedChecks` into a helper so it returns to/below its baseline of 15. Adding unit tests for the two uncovered empty-log branches (`'job log for N came back empty'`, `'check-run N log came back empty'`) also lowers CRAP directly and pins the loud contract.

**dmtools-factory-bot[bot]** (2026-10-18):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `ghResult.reason` masks the Jenkins-specific failure reason**

For a failed check whose `details_url` points at the configured Jenkins instance (URL matches `jenkinsBasePath`) but whose Jenkins log fetch throws or comes back empty, `ghResult.reason` is `'unsupported details_url shape: <jenkins-url>'` (the GitHub resolver never matches Jenkins URLs) and it wins here because it is checked first. The resulting `ci_failures.md` line says:

```text

```

— which is misleading: the shape IS supported; the Jenkins fetch failed. The whole point of gh-1045 is loud *accurate* diagnostics, and a rework leg reading this will look at the wrong thing. Prefer the Jenkins reason when the URL resolved to a Jenkins build target, e.g.:

```javascript
var reason = (jenkinsResult.reason && !jenkinsResult.skipped)
    ? jenkinsResult.reason
    : (ghResult.reason || jenkinsResult.reason || 'unknown fetch failure');
```

(The existing `skipped: true` outcome gives you the discriminator for foreign-host URLs, where the GitHub reason is the correct one.)

**dmtools-factory-bot[bot]** (2026-10-18):

- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71

- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

- [x] ▶ review (fa-review) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39130489993) · started 13:12 · done 13:27 ✅

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39129446238) · started 12:57 · done 13:11 ✅
- [x] ▶ review (fa-review) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39130489993) · started 13:12 · done 13:27 ✅

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:

crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +547
- **Deletions**: -71
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T14:29:40Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:

crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"

project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md,
